name: Sakurai Chika
source:
[url=/c5240]Kanade[/url]'s little sister.

Chika's at the age where she's a little precocious and trying to stretch herself, but when she's helping out at the live house, she's reliable like her sister.

She's been awfully attached to [url=/c4325]Shoichi[/url] since she was little, and even took off school to welcome him back to Japan.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/r18/Titles/Details/FC264AC0-795A-4FEB-AA09-56BAEF3B2FC3/deardrops]MangaGamer[/url]]
